description: Portail Open Data de la CC Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher is an open data portal listed in Portail Open Data de la CC Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Portail Open Data de la CC Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher. The portal lists 19 datasets published by Portail Open Data de la CC Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher for Autour de Chenonceaux (Indre-et-Loire); the ones about transport, energy, water and digital networks are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. Coverage: Autour de Chenonceaux (Indre-et-Loire). 19 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 5 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-cc-autourdechenonceaux-fr-portal.
